title: SOC 2 Type II — Trust Service Criteria

questions.question_text: Do you enforce MFA on all privileged accounts?
Is data encrypted at rest using AES-256 or equivalent?
Is data encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher?
Do you maintain a formal access control policy?
How frequently do you review and revoke unnecessary user access?
Do you conduct background checks on employees with access to sensitive data?
Is security awareness training mandatory for all employees?
Do you have a Web Application Firewall deployed?
Describe your vulnerability management and patch cadence.
Do you have a SIEM system?
Is 24/7 security monitoring in place?
What is your mean time to detect (MTTD) a security incident?
What is your mean time to respond (MTTR) to a security incident?
Do you have a formal incident response plan?
Has your incident response plan been tested in the last 12 months?
Do you conduct annual penetration testing?
Provide the date and scope of your most recent penetration test.
Do you have a bug bounty or responsible disclosure program?
What is your documented uptime SLA for production systems?
Do you have redundancy and failover for critical services?
What is your Recovery Time Objective (RTO)?
What is your Recovery Point Objective (RPO)?
Do you have data classification policies?
Is access to confidential data restricted on need-to-know basis?
Do you use Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tools?
Do you have input validation controls to prevent data corruption?
Are processing errors logged and alerted on?
Do you have a published privacy policy?
Do you obtain explicit consent before collecting personal data?
Do you provide users with the ability to access their personal data?
Do you have data retention and deletion policies?
Do you disclose data sharing with third parties?
Can users request deletion of their personal data?
Do you have a process to handle privacy complaints?
Are you compliant with GDPR, CCPA, or applicable privacy regulations?
Do you conduct annual privacy impact assessments?
Do you have endpoint detection and response (EDR) on all corporate devices?
Is your production infrastructure hosted in SOC 2 certified data centers?
Upload your most recent SOC 2 report or certification.
Do you have a formal change management process?
Are production changes peer-reviewed before deployment?
